# NEXARIUM

> Open Decentralized Web Infrastructure

## Overview

NEXARIUM is a decentralized and interoperable digital ecosystem focused on:

- Semantic Systems
- Decentralized Identity
- Identity Continuity
- Linked Data
- Machine-Readable Infrastructure
- Institutional Transparency
- Federated Communication
- Verification Infrastructure
- Long-Term Digital Persistence
- Web3 Continuity Systems

## Core Infrastructure

- https://www.nexarium.us
- https://www.nvo987.us
- https://www.nvo987.fr
- https://identity.nvo987.us
- https://valoriax.nvo987.fr
- https://fediverse.nvo987.us
- https://www.kellycode.us

## Infrastructure Layers

### Identity Infrastructure

Decentralized identity systems based on semantic interoperability,
DID-compatible structures,
and continuity-oriented identity architecture.

### VALORIAX

Institutional transparency infrastructure supporting
the financial transparency,
public accountability,
and long-term integrity
of the NVO987 association.

### Fediverse Infrastructure

Federated communication infrastructure connected
through ActivityPub-compatible technologies
including Mastodon and Misskey environments.

### Cryptographic Infrastructure

Parallel Web3 continuity infrastructure supporting
blockchain-based persistence,
verification,
and decentralized identity anchoring.
